limitations: Hazard and vulnerability refer to IRBI2013 baseline derived from provincial 2011 risk assessments; changes largely reflect capacity assessed through IKD.

Risk is not realized annual harm, disaster counts, a resident probability or a causal estimate. Underlying vulnerability may overlap socioeconomic conditions.
Original publication restricts quotation/reproduction. Original PDF is verified in memory and not redistributed; only attributed numeric facts and audit metadata retained.
